title: Construction of Similar Triangles — Constructions
hook: Let's explore Construction of Similar Triangles from the chapter on Constructions. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Construction of Similar Triangles Construct a triangle similar to a given triangle with sides in a given ratio (scale factor). Uses the line segment division technique. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Scale factor < 1: smaller similar triangle (inside)
💡 Scale factor > 1: larger similar triangle (outside)
💡 Steps: draw base, divide using ratio, draw parallel lines
💡 The constructed triangle has all angles equal to original
